dossier.headline: Realty gives back gains a day after its pre-sales rally
dossier.summary: Realty was the standout sector on November 12, with Nifty Realty up 3.4% by midday and about 4% at the close. Oberoi, Sobha and Lodha rose about 5% intraday, and DLF neared its 52-week high, after Jefferies said September-quarter pre-sales beat its estimates for DLF, Oberoi, Godrej Properties and Prestige. On November 13 the index fell 1% as Phoenix Mills and DLF weighed, amid broader selling in rate-sensitive sectors.
